mapper.sql: summary_date AS summaryDate, run_version AS runVersion, order_count AS orderCount, pending_order_count AS pendingOrderCount, paid_order_count AS paidOrderCount, cancelled_order_count AS cancelledOrderCount, total_amount AS totalAmount, source_start_at AS sourceStartAt, source_end_at AS sourceEndAt, execution_id AS executionId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PENDING') AS pendingOrderCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'PAID') AS paidOrderCount, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'CANCELLED') AS cancelledOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) AS totalAmount FROM orders WHERE created_at >= #{sourceStartAt} AND created_at < #{sourceEndAt}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xxl_order_summary ( summary_date, run_version, order_count, pending_order_count, paid_order_count, cancelled_order_count, total_amount, source_start_at, source_end_at, execution_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{summaryDate}, #{runVersion}, #{orderCount}, #{pendingOrderCount}, #{paidOrderCount}, #{cancelledOrderCount}, #{totalAmount}, #{sourceStartAt}, #{sourceEndAt}, #{executionId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (summary_date) DO UPDATE SET run_version = EXCLUDED.run_version, order_count = EXCLUDED.order_count, pending_order_count = EXCLUDED.pending_order_count, paid_order_count = EXCLUDED.paid_order_count, cancelled_order_count = EXCLUDED.cancelled_order_count, total_amount = EXCLUDED.total_amount, source_start_at = EXCLUDED.source_start_at, source_end_at = EXCLUDED.source_end_at, execution_id = EXCLUDED.execution_id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE xxl_order_summary.run_version < EXCLUDED.run_version
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM xxl_order_summary
ORDER BY summary_date DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
